Bless/Curse use a provisional flat preview. Freeze previews assume only that it is still active at action start; thaw is undecided.

Dusk & Dawn · 110 enemy proposals

110 uncanny encounters

Every enemy has an independently tuned action pool, one labeled trait and an explicit damage-type weakness. Values are not linked to player-card definitions.

Suppress the enemy’s labeled trait through its next action. Skip a non-attack ability; an attack keeps its base hits. Advance the pattern normally.

Health and damage are first-test values, not playtested balance. Binding and Release remain provisional damage labels. Encounter rules · Individual artwork review
